## What is derived

The generic `routingTrace_copy_selector` takes a supported actual routing trace, an INDEPENDENT-only word and nonrepeating original read sites. It constructs a separate original-site Boolean register witness for each copy whose deterministic position trace matches every actual trace position. Boundary support determines the current owner's actual selected parent. An unused site can be filled arbitrarily. The backward induction updates a head site's witness bit only after showing that the site is absent from the tail, preserving every later position. Interval entries are retained, so the later accumulated-rate comparison has the required positional information.

The concrete original-calendar endpoint discharges both word conditions. `actual_calendar_sites_nodup` reuses the accepted original atom census rather than reproving it; the filter maps only original hybrid-node atoms to their IDs, and equal surviving IDs imply the same original atom. Literal sorted dates and exit-before-node ordering remain, including ties. `actual_independent_prefix_trace_selector` derives the prefix conditions from the full compiled word and uses the actual initialized copy location.

The new witness banks are per-copy proof objects. This endpoint does not assert that distinct copies share a bank, that their banks have any particular joint probability law, or that a presampled independent-bank mixture equals the actual compiler. Inactive current-owner choices and merged roots remain governed by the actual boundary kernel. Those distinctions are essential for the next probability consumer.
